walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us (Travel and Tourism; Media and Technology; The Environment and Where People Live) — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us (Travel and Tourism; Media and Technology; The Environment and Where People Live) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us (Travel and Tourism; Media and Technology; The Environment and Where People Live).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence means 'I never use Facebook'?
options: Je n'utilise jamais Facebook.
Je n'utilise pas jamais Facebook.
Je utilise jamais Facebook.
Je n'utilise rien Facebook.
to download
to upload only
to delete
to send a text

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am using my phone right now' (emphasising the action is in progress)?
options: Je suis utilisant mon portable.
Je suis en train d'utiliser mon portable.
Je vais à Espagne.
Je vais utiliser mon portable.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'Currently, I am using social media' in French?
options: Récemment, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Je vais utiliser mon portable.
Actuellement, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Actually, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to Spain' in French?
options: Je vais utiliser mon portable.
Je viens en Espagne.
Je vais à Espagne.
Je vais en Espagne.
